resources.string: MeshCore companion bridge. Not field verified. Position is opt-in. Inbound markers are unverified.
Radio idle. Connect does not send position.
Room name. Empty sends all-chat on the chosen channel.
Chat text. See the Plugin users only switch for who can read it.

Plugin users only: binary channel data that only other copies of this ATAK plugin can read. The MeshCore app will NOT show it. "Sent to radio" means the radio accepted it, not that anyone received it.
Channels: connect first. Nothing is chosen for you.
Experimental: also copy ATAK GeoChat. Default off. Untested. Not a private radio path.
